buff.stacks: +1% experience per minute rested, up to 3 stacks
buff.restingSynergy: You also count as rested while lying in the bag, with a visible Resting aura indicating its area of effect. Cannot be used while mounted (Nov 17 hotfix).

studentFodder.name: Student Fodder
studentFodder.use: Regenerates health in Forever. 5-minute cooldown, stacks to 30. The questline hands out 5 in total.

source: Wowhead Forever guide: Cozy Sleeping Bag: Quests, Locations and Rewards

questRoadmap.name: ...and that note you found

factionStart.alliance: Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37, 50): click the Burned-Out Remains in the cart wreckage
factionStart.horde: Burnt tower south of Camp Taurajo, The Barrens (46, 74): click the Burned-Out Remains

questRoadmap.task: Accept the quest from the Burned-Out Remains in your faction's starting spot.

questRoadmap.name: Stepping Stones
questRoadmap.location: The other faction's starting spot (Barrens for Alliance, Westfall for Horde)
questRoadmap.task: Turn in "...and that note you found" at the other Burned-Out Remains and accept Stepping Stones.

questRoadmap.name: Scramble
questRoadmap.location: Stonetalon Mountains (path 50.9, 52.3 · camp 40.6, 52.4 · Mound of Dirt 39.6, 49.8)
questRoadmap.task: Click the Pocket Litter in the abandoned camp northeast of Sun Rock Retreat, then jump to the Mound of Dirt to complete Scramble and accept Wet Job. Optional: complete Rekindle at the camp's campfire.

questRoadmap.name: Wet Job
questRoadmap.task: Jump onto the carved heads facing the Wetlands and click the Eagle Figurine to complete Wet Job and accept Eagle's Fist.

questRoadmap.name: Eagle's Fist / This Must Be The Place
questRoadmap.task: Climb into the wall from the cart, click the hanging Messenger Bag, then the Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel below it.
